excerpts: FDA enforcement report D-332-2014 (classification Class II, initiated 20130808): Chemical Contamination: Novartis Pharmaceuticals Corporation has recalled physician sample bottles of Diovan, Exforge, Exforge HCT,Lescol XL, Stalevo, Tekturna .
FDA enforcement report D-0542-2025 (classification Class II, initiated 20250702): Labeling: Incorrect or Missing Lot and/or Exp Date: released with wrong expiry date as Feb.2027 instead of Jan.2027.

FDA enforcement report D-1143-2015 (classification Class III, initiated 20150506): Subpotent drug.
